I am an applied microeconomist. My research is in public and urban economics, with a particular interest in policies whose effects are heterogeneous across space or along the income and wealth distribution. Topics I work on include housing and transport policy, behavioural distortions from tax-benefit instruments, and the interaction between public interventions and local markets.

I am currently completing an MRes in Economics at [Sciences Po, Paris](https://www.sciencespo.fr/ecole-recherche/en.html), following a B.A. (Hons.) in Economics and Social Studies at [Trinity College Dublin](https://www.tcd.ie/). I am delighted to be moving to London in the autumn of 2026 to join [CenTax](https://centax.org.uk/) as a Research Economist.
